tierPolicy.1: Certified tournament feed or official publisher, league, organizer, or game API.
tierPolicy.2: Documented commercial aggregator or supported community/open data service.
tierPolicy.3: Public specialist or manual corroboration source without approved production ingestion rights.

statusPolicy.approved: May support an automated decision under the recorded access terms and role.
statusPolicy.approved_research: May support research corroboration but cannot authorize BET.
statusPolicy.contract_required: Requires a verified commercial agreement before use.
statusPolicy.terms_review_required: Terms or intended use require legal/operator review before use.
statusPolicy.blocked_policy: The published policy conflicts with betting functionality.
statusPolicy.manual_only: May be manually inspected and cited; automated ingestion is not approved.
statusPolicy.local_only: Valid only from an authorized local observer/client, not as a public pro feed.
